note: Method yieldPercent is the SCMiner 4.10.3 base: 32 SCU at 45% with no station bonus is 14.4 SCU. Station percent is the UEX refineries_yields value for that mineral at that terminal. Refined SCU = raw SCU x yieldPercent/100 x (1 + station percent/100). A mineral with no station row uses 0. Sell prices are UEX price_sell per SCU. A missing price is not a zero price. Lindinium, Ouratite, Aslarite, Stileron, Tin and Torite sells were added 2026-11-21. UEX leaves is_mineral at 0 for them. Ouratite is the sellable form of Ouratite (Raw) and is stored as refined.
